summary: Iteration 13 — verified 4 enhancements (Duplicate, Publish Success, Photo Auto-center, Accent Picker) + regression. FOUND & FIXED one CRITICAL backend regression: PUT /api/admin/cards/{card_id} was returning 405 Method Not Allowed because @api_router.put decorator was accidentally deleted when duplicate_card was inserted (server.py line 545). Restored decorator; card editing now works. Backend tests 6/6 PASS. Frontend E2E: duplicate creates draft copy with correct slug pattern → published card publish-success screen renders with QR/link/copy/view/dashboard, link=<origin>/<slug>, QR src=/api/cards/<slug>/qr, dashboard nav OK; draft flow shows 'Draft saved' toast and routes to /admin; photo auto-center transforms img from matrix(1,0,0,1,0,0) → matrix(1.15,0,0,1.15,0,9.36) matching heuristic; accent swatch swap changes hero-name color live (purple→emerald verified). Regression: /feras-askar gold intact (rgb(201,162,75)), no console errors, no horizontal overflow at 1440 or 390. All test-created cards deleted; feras-askar untouched.

FRONTEND_duplicate.duplicate_button_testid_pattern: duplicate-{slug} (NOT duplicate-template-hub-184 as stated in review request)

FRONTEND_photo_autocenter.notes: Heuristic path (no FaceDetector in chromium) — matches expected scale~1.15, offsetY~6

FRONTEND_accent_picker.notes: Programmatic 'input' event on the color input did not visibly update the live preview (browser color inputs typically require user interaction). Native user interaction is expected to work; not blocking since swatch swap already updates preview.

critical_code_review_comments: CRITICAL FIX APPLIED: /app/backend/server.py line ~545 lost the '@api_router.put("/admin/cards/{card_id}")' decorator when the duplicate endpoint was inserted right above it — every card Edit save would have silently failed with 405. Restored. Regression test added (test_update_card_still_works).
duplicate_card uses re.sub to strip a trailing '-copy(-xxx)?' before generating a new suffix — clean, prevents ever-growing slugs. Good.

The 'accent-custom' color <input type='color'> only propagates via native user interaction (onChange). Consider also listening to onInput so programmatic tests and copy-paste hex work. Not a user-visible bug.

CreateCard.save() uses form.slug.trim() || name.slugify() — if user types only into the slug field with capitals/spaces (as I did in an earlier test), it becomes the source of truth. Consider always slugifying the entered slug to be idempotent (already does .toLowerCase().replace() so this is fine).
ProfilePhotoField autoCenter chromium fallback returns imageScale=1.15, imageOffsetY≈6, offsetX=0 — deterministic and reasonable. Consider bounding zoom range with visible min/max labels.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (Duplicate + Publish Success + Draft flow + Photo Auto-center + Accent picker + regression all PASS)

context_for_next_testing_agent: The PUT /admin/cards/{card_id} decorator regression was fixed in server.py. If similar 'inserted new route above existing one' patterns appear again, always check that subsequent decorators are intact — a simple grep 'async def.*card' vs '@api_router' count is a good sanity check. All 4 iteration-13 enhancements verified end-to-end.
rca of the issue: Duplicate endpoint insertion at /app/backend/server.py:524 accidentally consumed the following '@api_router.put("/admin/cards/{card_id}")' decorator line, leaving update_card as an unregistered plain async function. Result: every edit-card PUT returned 405. Reproduction: authenticate → POST /api/admin/cards to create → PUT /api/admin/cards/{id} → observe 405. Fix: re-add the '@api_router.put("/admin/cards/{card_id}")' decorator on the line preceding update_card. Verified with new pytest test_update_card_still_works (now PASS).
